messages.author: f43779383d79b3e4
messages.subject: Change order
parts:
Hey, I'm trying to make a plot with my regression estimates, but I would like to present the coefficients in order of size. Someone know how to do it?

Below is my code!

data <-data.frame(x=c("Intercept","Cabinet","Ideology", "Pork","Constituency","Poverty","Budget","Terms","Cabinet*Ideology","Pork*Constituency"),y=c(coef(mod1)[1],coef(mod1)[2],coef(mod1)[3],coef(mod1)[4],coef(mod1)[5],coef(mod1)[6],coef(mod1)[7],coef(mod1)[8],coef(mod1)[14],coef(mod1)[15]),z=c(se.coef(mod1)[1],se.coef(mod1)[2],se.coef(mod1)[3],se.coef(mod1)[4],se.coef(mod1)[5],se.coef(mod1)[6],se.coef(mod1)[7],se.coef(mod1)[8],se.coef(mod1)[12],se.coef(mod1)[13]))


data <- transform(data, ylo= y-(1.96*z), yhi= y+(1.96*z))


data <- data[order(data$y),]


fit.graph <- function (data) {

require(ggplot2)

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x=x,y=y, ymin=ylo, ymax=yhi))+geom_pointrange() +coord_flip()+ geom_hline(aes(x=0),lty=2)+ xlab('Variables')+ ylab('Effect Size')+ opts(title="Pooled Model 1 (OLS), 2005-2010")

return(p)

}


fit.graph(data)

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Change order
parts:
Hi, you need to order not data but the levels of factor.
Here is a minimum example.

d <- data.frame(x=letters[1:10], y=sample(10))
d$x <- reorder(d$x, rank(d$y))
ggplot(d, aes(x,y)) + geom_point()

parts:
I often find it useful to maintain the rank/order/sort that is already set in my data frames, so sometimes in situ reordering is best (and possible) just for the purpose of visualization a la:

ggplot(d, aes(reorder(x, rank(y)) ,y)) + geom_point()
